about: 现成模型的目录：只存指针、出处和许可，不存数据本身；模型在运行时从原地址下载。 / A catalogue of ready-made models: pointers, provenance and licences only, never the data; models are downloaded from their home at run time.

models.title: 新冠病毒颗粒

string.name: 基因组 RNA
string.basis: 冷冻电镜断层扫描看到新冠病毒里的核糖核蛋白是“一串珠子”：一个个核蛋白团块由同一条约三万碱基的 RNA 串着（Yao 等，Cell 2020，doi:10.1016/j.cell.2020.09.018）。模型里只有团块，没有 RNA；Goodsell 的画里也是一条线串着它们。
string.basisEn: Cryo-electron tomography shows the ribonucleoprotein inside SARS-CoV-2 as "beads on a string": clumps of nucleoprotein strung on one RNA of about thirty thousand bases (Yao et al., Cell 2020, doi:10.1016/j.cell.2020.09.018). The model holds the clumps and no RNA; Goodsell's painting likewise shows one strand stringing them.

respike.source: Neuman et al., J. Struct. Biol. 2011, doi:10.1016/j.jsb.2010.11.021 (74 on average for coronavirus particles); Klein et al., Nat. Commun. 2020, doi:10.1038/s41467-020-19619-7 (48 on average, range 25-127, for SARS-CoV-2)

environment.basis: 照 Goodsell 的《Coronavirus》（2020，doi:10.2210/rcsb_pdb/goodsell-gallery-019），他画的是刚进入呼吸道的病毒，周围是黏液（黏蛋白的长链）、分泌的抗体和几种小的蛋白。这里用一个抗体结构（PDB 1IGT）和血清白蛋白（PDB 1AO6）代表蛋白，黏蛋白画成随机走向的长线。
environment.basisEn: After Goodsell's "Coronavirus" (2020, doi:10.2210/rcsb_pdb/goodsell-gallery-019), which shows the virus just entering the airways, surrounded by mucus (long mucin strands), secreted antibodies and several small proteins. Here one antibody structure (PDB 1IGT) and serum albumin (PDB 1AO6) stand for the proteins, and mucin is drawn as long strands on random courses.

models.caption: 整颗病毒的原子模型，从中间剖开：包膜上的刺突蛋白（S）、膜蛋白（M）和包膜蛋白（E），内部是核衣壳蛋白与 RNA 组成的核糖核蛋白。
models.captionEn: An atomic model of the whole virus, cut through the middle: the spike (S), membrane (M) and envelope (E) proteins in the envelope, and inside it the ribonucleoprotein of nucleocapsid protein and RNA.
models.citation: Ozvoldik et al., J. Chem. Inf. Model. 2021, doi:10.1021/acs.jcim.1c00743

models.title: HIV-1 病毒颗粒

respike.source: Zhu et al., Nature 2006, doi:10.1038/nature04817 (14 ± 7 envelope spikes per HIV-1 virion, by cryo-electron tomography; 21 is the upper end of that range and not the mean, chosen because the user found 14 too sparse; the spikes there are not evenly spread, and the even arrangement drawn here is an idealisation)

environment.basis: 照 Goodsell 的《HIV in Blood Plasma》（doi:10.2210/rcsb_pdb/goodsell-gallery-002），病毒泡在血浆里。血浆里最多的三类蛋白是白蛋白、免疫球蛋白和纤维蛋白原，这里各用一个结构代表（PDB 1AO6、1IGT、3GHG）。
environment.basisEn: After Goodsell's "HIV in Blood Plasma" (doi:10.2210/rcsb_pdb/goodsell-gallery-002), in which the virus sits in blood plasma. The three most abundant classes of plasma protein are albumin, immunoglobulins and fibrinogen, each stood for here by one structure (PDB 1AO6, 1IGT, 3GHG).

models.caption: 成熟 HIV-1 病毒颗粒的原子模型，从中间剖开：包膜上的 gp160 刺突，膜下的基质蛋白，锥形衣壳里是两条基因组 RNA 和逆转录酶、整合酶。
models.captionEn: An atomic model of the mature HIV-1 virion, cut through the middle: gp160 spikes in the envelope, matrix protein beneath the membrane, and a conical capsid holding the two genomic RNAs with reverse transcriptase and integrase.
models.attribution: Kornel Ozvoldik, Elmar Krieger and the cellPACK team (YASARA PetWorld)
models.citation: Ozvoldik et al., J. Chem. Inf. Model. 2021, doi:10.1021/acs.jcim.1c00743

models.title: 流感病毒颗粒（H1N1，整个包膜）
models.titleEn: An influenza virion (H1N1, the whole envelope)
models.caption: 一整个甲型流感病毒颗粒的包膜，从中间剖开：膜上插着 236 个血凝素三聚体和 30 个神经氨酸酶四聚体，带着它们的糖链，还有 11 个 M2 质子通道（只有跨膜的那一段）。包膜和膜上的蛋白是一次全原子分子动力学模拟的最后一帧。模拟里没有病毒内部的东西；里面那层基质蛋白、八条核糖核蛋白和聚合酶是按已知结构推断着补上的，位置不是测到的。
models.captionEn: The envelope of an entire influenza A virion, cut through the middle: 236 hemagglutinin trimers and 30 neuraminidase tetramers stand in the membrane with their glycans, along with 11 M2 proton channels (their membrane-spanning part only). The envelope and its proteins are the last frame of an all-atom molecular dynamics simulation. The simulation holds nothing of the inside of the virus; the matrix layer, the eight ribonucleoproteins and the polymerases there are filled in by inference from known structures, and where they sit was not measured.
models.attribution: Lorenzo Casalino, Christian Seitz, Rommie Amaro 等（加州大学圣迭戈分校 Amaro 实验室）
models.attributionEn: Lorenzo Casalino, Christian Seitz, Rommie Amaro and colleagues (Amaro Lab, UC San Diego)
models.citation: Casalino et al., ACS Cent. Sci. 2022, doi:10.1021/acscentsci.2c00981

models.title: 突触小泡
models.caption: 一个突触小泡的原子模型，从中间剖开：膜上有质子泵 V-ATPase、谷氨酸转运体 VGLUT、SNARE 蛋白和突触结合蛋白，里面装着谷氨酸。
models.captionEn: An atomic model of a synaptic vesicle, cut through the middle: its membrane carries the proton pump V-ATPase, the glutamate transporter VGLUT, SNARE proteins and synaptotagmin, and it is filled with glutamate.
models.citation: Ozvoldik et al., J. Chem. Inf. Model. 2021, doi:10.1021/acs.jcim.1c00743

proteins.name: 细胞质里的可溶蛋白（示意）

environment.basis: 照 Goodsell 的《Excitatory and Inhibitory Synapses》（doi:10.2210/rcsb_pdb/goodsell-gallery-016），小泡泡在突触前末梢拥挤的细胞质里，周围是可溶蛋白和细丝。这里可溶蛋白用一个大小相当的蛋白（PDB 2HHB）占位，大的复合体用 GroEL（PDB 1AON）占位，细丝画成长线。
environment.basisEn: After Goodsell's "Excitatory and Inhibitory Synapses" (doi:10.2210/rcsb_pdb/goodsell-gallery-016), where vesicles sit in the crowded cytoplasm of the presynaptic terminal among soluble proteins and filaments. Here soluble proteins are stood for by a protein of about the right size (PDB 2HHB), large complexes by GroEL (PDB 1AON), and filaments are drawn as long strands.

models.title: 突触前膨体（整个）
models.attribution: Burkhard Rammner, Kornel Ozvoldik, Elmar Krieger (YASARA PetWorld)
models.caption: 一整个突触前膨体的模型，从中间剖开：307 个装着谷氨酸的突触小泡、细胞骨架、内体、线粒体的外壳和质膜，以及几十种参与小泡释放与回收的蛋白，数量来自对分离出的突触小体的定量测量。
models.captionEn: A model of an entire presynaptic bouton, cut through the middle: 307 synaptic vesicles filled with glutamate, cytoskeleton, endosomes, the mitochondrial envelope and the plasma membrane, with dozens of the proteins that release and recycle vesicles, in numbers taken from quantitative measurements of isolated synaptic boutons.
models.citation: Wilhelm et al., Science 2014, doi:10.1126/science.1252884; Ozvoldik et al., J. Chem. Inf. Model. 2021, doi:10.1021/acs.jcim.1c00743

models.title: 突触后的树突棘（蘑菇型，整个）
models.attribution: Burkhard Rammner, Kornel Ozvoldik, Elmar Krieger (YASARA PetWorld)

proteins.name: 细胞外的可溶蛋白（示意）

strands.name: 细胞外基质的长链（示意）

environment.basis: 照 Goodsell 的《Excitatory and Inhibitory Synapses》（doi:10.2210/rcsb_pdb/goodsell-gallery-016），他的画面没有空着的地方。脑里细胞外的基质以透明质酸长链为骨架，上面挂着刷子状的蛋白聚糖（aggrecan、brevican 等），这里画成分叉的长线；可溶蛋白用一个大小相当的蛋白（PDB 2HHB）占位。要注意：真实的脑组织里细胞外的空间只是几十纳米宽的缝，这片地方大部分其实是邻近的细胞（轴突、胶质细胞），模型里没有它们，这里用基质填满是为了画面，不是实际的样子。
environment.basisEn: After Goodsell's "Excitatory and Inhibitory Synapses" (doi:10.2210/rcsb_pdb/goodsell-gallery-016), where no part of the sheet is left empty. The brain's extracellular matrix is built on long chains of hyaluronan carrying brush-like proteoglycans (aggrecan, brevican and others), drawn here as branched strands; soluble proteins are stood for by a protein of about the right size (PDB 2HHB). Note that in real brain tissue the extracellular space is a cleft a few tens of nanometres wide, and most of this area is in fact neighbouring cells (axons, glia), which the model does not hold; filling it with matrix serves the picture and is not how it really is.

models.caption: 一整个蘑菇型树突棘的模型，从中间剖开：细胞骨架、内体、线粒体的外壳和质膜，以及一百多种突触后的蛋白，数量来自对树突棘的超分辨成像和生化定量。
models.captionEn: A model of an entire mushroom-type dendritic spine, cut through the middle: cytoskeleton, endosomes, the mitochondrial envelope and the plasma membrane, with over a hundred kinds of postsynaptic protein, in numbers taken from super-resolution imaging and biochemical quantification of dendritic spines.
models.citation: Helm et al., Nat. Neurosci. 2021, doi:10.1038/s41593-021-00874-w; Ozvoldik et al., J. Chem. Inf. Model. 2021, doi:10.1021/acs.jcim.1c00743

models.title: 生命的机器（Goodsell 与 Autin）
models.caption: David Goodsell 与 Ludovic Autin 把《生命的机器》里的分子放进同一个三维场景：按比例排在一起的上百种蛋白、核酸和膜。
models.captionEn: David Goodsell and Ludovic Autin put the molecules of The Machinery of Life into a single three-dimensional scene: more than a hundred kinds of protein, nucleic acid and membrane arranged together to scale.
models.licenceEn: No licence stated with the file

models.title: 生殖支原体整细胞

fringe.name: 荚膜的多糖长链（照他的画；这个物种未必有）
fringe.nameEn: capsular polysaccharide chains (after his painting; this species may not have them)

strands.name: 染色体 DNA（重新画的走向）

environment.basis: 照 Goodsell 的《Mycoplasma mycoides》（doi:10.2210/rcsb_pdb/goodsell-gallery-011），他把 DNA 画成直而稀的长线。生殖支原体的基因组是 58 万碱基对，拉直约 197 微米；画面里的切片约占细胞体积的五分之一，按比例应有约 42 微米，这里只画了约 36 微米（60 条，每条 600 纳米），为的是看得清，和他的画一样稀。走向是随机生成的，比真实 DNA（持久长度约 50 纳米）直得多。细胞外面那一圈绿色的乱线也是照他那幅画加的：他画的丝状支原体（M. mycoides）有多糖荚膜；这个模型是生殖支原体（M. genitalium），没有查到它有这样的荚膜，这一圈是为了画面，不是这个物种的实际样子。
environment.basisEn: After Goodsell's "Mycoplasma mycoides" (doi:10.2210/rcsb_pdb/goodsell-gallery-011), in which DNA is long, straight and sparse. The genome of Mycoplasma genitalium is 580 thousand base pairs, about 197 micrometres stretched out; the slab in the picture is about a fifth of the cell's volume, which in proportion would hold about 42 micrometres; only about 36 are drawn here (60 strands of 600 nanometres), to keep the picture readable and as sparse as his. The courses are generated at random and are far straighter than real DNA (persistence length about 50 nanometres). The fringe of tangled green strands outside the cell is also after that painting: the Mycoplasma mycoides he painted has a polysaccharide capsule; this model is Mycoplasma genitalium, for which no such capsule was found on record, and the fringe serves the picture and is not how this species really is.

models.caption: 一整只生殖支原体细胞的模型，从中间剖开：膜、核糖体、基因组 DNA 和几百种蛋白，数量来自全细胞模拟的一个时刻。
models.captionEn: A model of an entire Mycoplasma genitalium cell, cut through the middle: membrane, ribosomes, genomic DNA and several hundred kinds of protein, in numbers taken from one moment of a whole-cell simulation.
models.attribution: Martina Maritan, Ludovic Autin, Jonathan Karr, Markus Covert, Arthur Olson, David Goodsell
models.citation: Maritan et al., J. Mol. Biol. 2022, doi:10.1016/j.jmb.2021.167351

models.title: 最小细胞 JCVI-syn3A 的膜包层
models.titleEn: The membrane envelope of the minimal cell JCVI-syn3A

environment.basis: 照 Goodsell 的《JCVI-syn3A Minimal Cell》（2022，doi:10.2210/rcsb_pdb/goodsell-gallery-042），他画的细胞里是黄色的染色体 DNA 长线、品红的核糖体和蓝色的可溶蛋白。这里核糖体用支原体的结构（PDB 7P6Z），伴侣蛋白用 GroEL（PDB 1AON），小的可溶蛋白用一个大小相当的蛋白（PDB 2HHB）占位，DNA 画成随机走向的长线。
environment.basisEn: After Goodsell's "JCVI-syn3A Minimal Cell" (2022, doi:10.2210/rcsb_pdb/goodsell-gallery-042), in which the cell holds long yellow strands of chromosomal DNA, magenta ribosomes and blue soluble proteins. Here ribosomes use a mycoplasma structure (PDB 7P6Z), the chaperonin is GroEL (PDB 1AON), small soluble proteins are stood for by a protein of about the right size (PDB 2HHB), and DNA is drawn as long strands on random courses.

models.caption: 人工合成的最小细胞 JCVI-syn3A 的膜包层，从中间剖开：一个直径约 200 nm 的球形膜，上面嵌着 998 条膜蛋白链。这是一次粗粒度分子动力学模拟的起始构型，只有膜和膜蛋白，细胞里面的东西不在其中。
models.captionEn: The membrane envelope of the synthetic minimal cell JCVI-syn3A, cut through the middle: a spherical membrane about 200 nm across with 998 membrane protein chains set in it. This is the starting configuration of a coarse-grained molecular dynamics simulation; it holds the membrane and its proteins only, and nothing of what is inside the cell.
models.attribution: Mert Bozoflu, Jan Adriaan Stevens, Marco van Tilburg, Bart Bruininks, Chelsea Brown, Siewert Marrink
models.citation: Bozoflu et al., simulation data for "Lipid Composition Directs Membrane Organization in Minimal Cells", Zenodo 2026, doi:10.5281/zenodo.21173344

models.title: 完整的 HIV-1 衣壳
models.caption: 由 1356 条衣壳蛋白链围成的锥形衣壳（186 个六聚体、12 个五聚体），冷冻电镜与全原子模拟得到的模型。
models.captionEn: The conical capsid enclosed by 1356 capsid protein chains (186 hexamers and 12 pentamers), a model from cryo-electron microscopy and all-atom simulation.

models.title: 寨卡病毒
models.caption: 成熟寨卡病毒颗粒的外壳：180 份包膜蛋白 E 和膜蛋白 M 按二十面体对称铺满表面。
models.captionEn: The shell of the mature Zika virion: 180 copies each of the envelope protein E and the membrane protein M cover the surface with icosahedral symmetry.

models.title: 登革病毒

models.title: 人的核孔复合体
models.caption: 人核孔复合体的骨架（收缩态），由冷冻电镜断层扫描和结构预测整合得到。
models.captionEn: The scaffold of the human nuclear pore complex (constricted state), from cryo-electron tomography integrated with structure prediction.

models.caption: 裂殖酵母核孔复合体的整合结构模型，189 万个原子。

models.title: 核孔的 Nup84 亚复合体（粗粒度整合模型）
models.titleEn: Nup84 subcomplex of the nuclear pore (coarse integrative model)
models.caption: 七种蛋白组成的 Y 形复合体。每个小球代表一段残基，位置由交联质谱和电镜数据整合确定，不是原子坐标。
models.captionEn: A Y-shaped complex of seven proteins. Each bead stands for a stretch of residues, placed by integrating cross-linking mass spectrometry and electron microscopy data; these are not atomic coordinates.

models.title: 细胞里核糖体的真实分布和朝向（冷冻电镜断层扫描）
models.titleEn: Where the ribosomes are in a cell, and which way they face (cryo-electron tomography)
models.caption: 一只肺炎支原体细胞的一片冷冻电镜断层扫描里，331 个核糖体各自的位置和朝向。每个位置上放的是同一种细胞里解出的 70S 核糖体原子模型。细胞膜和其他分子没有画。
models.captionEn: The positions and orientations of 331 ribosomes in one cryo-electron tomogram of Mycoplasma pneumoniae cells. At each stands the atomic model of the 70S ribosome solved in the same kind of cell. The cell membrane and all other molecules are not drawn.
